_comment: Dork builder reference templates: emitted queries only, never executed. Severity describes potential exposure, not evidence or confidence. All people and affiliation hits remain leads.

platforms._comment: Document hosts and exposure rationale; damage severity applies only if an analyst verifies a hit.

filetypes._comment: File extension query families graded by potential exposure rather than likelihood of a result.

severity_order._comment: Severity ranking used to sort and apply the inclusive CLI severity threshold.

engines._comment: Search-engine entry URLs for manual querying only; no automated requests are made.

patterns._comment: A plain DNS hostname is treated as an organisation domain; company names never invent a mailbox domain.

staff_emails._comment: Public staff-name and email mentions are discovery leads, never proof of employment or mailbox ownership.
